title: 5G/UAS Wireless-Security Co-Simulation Dataset and Reproducibility Artifact for AI-Assisted Security Monitoring
description: Companion dataset and reproducibility artifact for the manuscript “AI-Assisted Security Monitoring in 5G-Enabled UAS Wireless Networks: Run-Wise Validation and Cross-Domain Transfer”. Includes the 17,779-row/43-run co-simulation aggregate, 43 deterministic per-run files, 43 source YAML manifests, the 10,000-row synthetic reference, schema/validator, source co-simulation pipeline material, original window-level model report, matched run-wise validation, complete RF/HGB zero-shot transfer results, distribution-shift analysis, exact manuscript figures, and representative run provenance. Companion Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22709680.
